subject: Media Literacy
title: Advertising Regulation
description: Learn Advertising Regulation in one minute.

hook.text: In the 1950s, tobacco ads featured doctors recommending cigarettes. Regulation eventually stopped that.

buildup.text: Advertising regulations prevent false claims, protect children, and require disclosures for certain products.

discovery.text: The FTC requires ads to be truthful and substantiated. Violations can result in fines and forced corrections.

twist.text: Digital advertising largely evades regulation. Influencer marketing and native ads operate in gray areas.

climax.text: Regulation keeps traditional ads honest. But the newest advertising formats are mostly unregulated.

punchline.text: Old ads have rules. New ads make their own.

quiz.question: Why is digital advertising harder to regulate than traditional advertising?
options: Formats like influencer marketing operate in regulatory gray areas
